name: Overfarmed! [Factories]
desc:
Farm and expand your fields to earn the most money!

- 🌾 Unlock or forage for new crops!
- 🧑‍🌾 Upgrade and automate equipment!
- 🎣 Go fishing for unique catches!
- 🐦‍⬛ Defend your farm against crows!
- 🏭 Use your crops to manufacture goods!

PC Controls:
Ctrl - Toggle Sprint
B/X - Open Place/Delete mode
G/E - Sell/Replant Highlighted Item
R/F - Water/Fertilize Crop
P - Plant Last Crop on All Tiles
L - Sell All Crops

👥 Play with friends with private servers or by sharing your server code!

Join the community: https://www.roblox.com/communities/34633422/Lumidex#!/about
Report bugs/issues through the Feedback menu in settings.
